messages:
Marco (sales): EmberBolt POC ask — customer wants a tight perf benchmark + price options. Targets: p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 360ms at 24 qps steady, with two 50s spikes to 96 qps. Mixed prompts (45% short ~32t, 35% mid ~128t, 20% long ~512t). KV cache on (~52% hits). Need run plan, infra rec, hosted vs reserved delta, and an explicit note about int8 tradeoffs by Tue EOD. cc @Priya @Yasmin

Yasmin (SE): Copy. Proposed plan:
- Warm 2m @6 qps
- Ramp 6->24 qps over 4m
- Sustain 24 qps 18m (collect p50/p90/p95/p99 + seq-len buckets + cache-hit tag)
- 2x 50s spikes to 96 qps spaced 2m apart
- Run fp16 baseline then int8 quant run; tag runs clearly
I'll provide k6 snippets and HDR histogram export.

Oren (infra): Recommend dedicated 2-node A100-equivalent pool to avoid noisy neighbors. Per-GPU inflight cap ~44, batch size 1 for latency targets. Will provision test pool and run kernel-canary first (long prompts can move p99).

Yasmin (SE): Measurement & outputs: request-level csv with seqlen/cache flags, tail heatmap, per-bucket p95, resource utilization time series, and cost worksheet (hosted per-1k-token vs reserved amortized).

Marco (sales): Customer also asked: can Redwood provide customer-managed KMS and VPC for dedicated? Audit Q attached separately.

audit-bot: Security summary: Dedicated supports customer KMS and VPC peering. Audit logs retained 90d by default; extended retention available. SOC2 attestation available under NDA.

Priya (AE): Customer confirmed Tue slot. They'll upload a 1k-sample corpus by Fri for token sizing. Marco — include quick note on SLA tiers and recovery behavior during bursts in the deliverable.

Yasmin (SE): Will deliver runbook, k6 artifacts, CSV histograms, and cost calc by Tue EOD. Note: int8 typically reduces cost ~30% but expect +8-20ms on p95 for medium/long prompts; we'll quantify in results.

Marco (sales): Thanks team. :thumbsup:
